scenes.text: Area is the surface covered in square units. For a rectangle, multiply length by width.
Find the area of a 11 cm by 9 cm rectangle. The answer is 99 cm squared . A equals l times w gives 99 cm squared .
A rectangular garden during a sports day measures 14 cm by 6 cm on a model. What is its area? Pause the video and think.
A rectangular garden during a sports day measures 14 cm by 6 cm on a model. What is its area? The answer is 84 cm squared . A equals l times w gives 84 cm squared .
